name: jev
description: Jev tool routing for Claude Code, with a live dashboard and optional model and subagent planning.

provider.title: Jev provider
provider.description: Where to reach Jev: auto (JEV_PROVIDER, else the first provider key in the environment, else typesafe), typesafe, openrouter, vercel or opencode. Setup saves its choice here

api_key.title: Jev API key
api_key.description: Optional sensitive credential. The masked Setup field can save it through Claude Code's sensitive plugin configuration; the plugin never writes it to its own state. Set provider to match the key's issuer; auto cannot infer the provider from api_key, so under auto it is sent only to TypeSafe, and a provider auto-detected from its environment variable gets that variable's key instead. Jev sends recent conversation/tool data and composed Claude instructions to the selected provider. If empty, the plugin reads the selected provider's environment variable.

model.title: Jev model
model.description: Jev model id; empty uses the provider's default

min_confidence.title: Minimum confidence
min_confidence.description: Below this share (0 to 1), Jev's pick is ignored and Claude decides alone. Empty uses JEV_MIN_CONFIDENCE, else 0.7; a value outside 0 to 1 is ignored

timeout_ms.title: Jev timeout (ms)
timeout_ms.description: How long one Jev call may take, retry included, before failing open. Empty uses JEV_TIMEOUT_MS, else 4000; held between 500 and 30000

locale.title: Language
locale.description: Dashboard, commands and hints language. Auto follows the system locale.

routing_locale.title: Jev question language
routing_locale.description: Language of Jev's decision questions and criteria, independent of the dashboard. User conversation text is preserved.

claude_models.title: Claude routing candidates
claude_models.description: Optional comma-separated first-party Haiku, Sonnet and Opus model IDs supported by your account. Empty uses the built-in IDs. Models that fail twice are excluded for the session.
